cohort: This study included all women who delivered at the Soroka University Medical Center (SUMC) from 1988 to 2017, with mothers of offspring with IEM in the study group and mothers of offspring without IEM in the comparison group.
finding: This study found an independent association between inborn errors of metabolism (IEM) in offspring and specific complications of pregnancy, including preterm birth, polyhydramnios, and fetal growth restriction.
birth_weight: Neonates with IEM had lower mean birth weight
